steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Leader.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Phantom Crossbowmen, I'm glad to see you've returned safely.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You brought so many. Are they all our people from Lungmen?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: There are so many Infected... who came back with us.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: I didn't think we'd meet you here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We can save a lot of lives making full use of Chernobog's resources . This core city will be our final weapon to breach Lungmen.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: What? No, my Leader...

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Why was Lungmen so different from what we planned? So many of our comrades died back there for nothing!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You dare speak to the leader like this...?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No, he's right.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Many of our dear friends have suffered so much. The enemy left a lot of treacherous traps for us that disrupted our plans. It was a major setback.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: However, even if our pioneers faced some obstacles, the Reunion Movement will avenge them. I shall see to it that your wounds, your sacrifices, are made whole again.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Worry not. We will be with you, always.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...I hope so, Leader.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Hmm... The person you're carrying... Mephisto? Is he...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Faust sacrificed himself to save him, didn't he?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...That's right, Leader. With no regard for his own life, Faust used his Arts to cover our tracks and give us a chance to escape.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Phantom Crossbowmen, my people of Reunion... Faust will live on forever in our hearts.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Help him down. Mephisto will need to rest awhile.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I will have some men take you to camp.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Another thing, Leader... We lost contact with Crownslayer early on. We haven't heard anything from her. Don't know where she might have ended up.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: As for... Yeti Squad, and FrostNova, they... they're all...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Truly unfathomably tragic news.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Please, allow me... some time to myself.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Sarkaz, do not let them near any of our Reunion units in the city.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: How far do we go?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: All the way. See to it that they never set foot here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Could they be hiding something, or have they been digging around? Their team must know something I don't.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Maybe... that battle was somewhat transformative. Those Arts were already exceptional, and he was not talkative.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...He cloaked himself in his silence. I thought Faust would be the one to survive.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But then, this isn't so strange either.
...Who are you?
Who am I?
What do you want?
What do I want...?
Join... you? Fight for myself?
Fight...?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Ahh, for the exalted Ursus.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Here you were supposed to be the last one standing.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Looks like the core city is back up to speed. It didn't stop for long.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: On the upside, that should have been Reunion taking in a group of Infected migrants from Lungmen. I hope...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But we may have to change up our strategy.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We can expect the city to make a few more stops along the way until the enemy commander decides to announce her plan. Then she'll stop taking in Infected refugees.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At that time, should Wei Yenwu decide to attack, the enemy will redeploy their defensive units. We may be exposed in the process, and come under attack.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope our agreement with Miss Fumizuki will buy us some time from Chief Wei...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm.. we're already very close to the center of the core city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are a lot of passages above and below us that seem like they were part of the city's transit system. After the Catastrophe, everything stopped working.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That does mean it's impossible for the city to function, and even move...? Could this be the underground structure Dr. Kal'tsit was talking about?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Regardless, these passages make good cover for us. The number of enemy guards has nearly doubled in this storage area close to the central district...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We haven't seen much resistance since entering the core city. But once we proceed to the central district, we should expect to run into a lot more Reunion forces.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The recon and spec ops teams are already in position. So far so good.

options: Why do we only have three teams working together?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The recon and spec ops teams both have their own missions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian is leading the recon team for this operation, as one of Rhodes Island's communications specialists.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Thanks to Raidian, the recon team serves as the focal point for our comms in this operation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even here in the core city, we'll be able to communicate with the other teams. That's because of their hard work.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The recon team always works alone.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Outcast, Raidian, and Scout, who heroically gave his life in the Chernobog rescue mission—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The elite operators leading the recon teams are responsible for leading their squads alone, identifying and reporting threats, and attempting to resolve them without assistance.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian isn't as skilled in combat as the other two elite operators, but she is a unique talent at Rhodes Island when it comes to directly influencing the course of a battle.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've got three teams engaging in this assault operation. We don't need Raidian to trouble herself with combat.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for the spec ops team, their mission also avoids direct combat.

options: So you're not going to tell me what it is?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's enough to know that they're necessary. You'll know the details soon enough.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Each team makes up a link in the chain of our strategy. That stable structure breeds a stable result.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Conversely, a formidable opponent has a tangled and twisted root structure. They pull in nutrients from every level. Hacking off branches does them no harm.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We have to set their roots alight before they even know we're here.

options: Huh? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Heh. I'm pretty sure you get it all...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Doctor.'

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Wait a second.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Some distant, vague feelings are coming to me.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: An orderly, unchanging flow, with no conflict.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Ironclad. And they're moving.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Reunion's... guard team. Let's avoid them and find another way...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No time to lose.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Careful. Can't you feel it?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Attention, operators... protective gear on.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...It couldn't be... Rosmontis? Are you feeling any anomalies?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hm...? No. I don't think so.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is beyond Rosmontis's Arts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can't rely entirely on emotions, Amiya. There is more to feel than feelings alone. When you run your fingers through a head of hair, the first thing you feel is neither longing nor joy. It's something more base than that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Base...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can go back up to the surface from the depths, Amiya. Only you can.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then I'll try, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nnh... There's a sliver of... energy. And a strong scent in the air, like...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...a corpse?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, this isn't a real corpse. Could it be...? No. Oh? Why...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...It's Sarkaz. Sarkaz Arts. Thick with the smell of death... A ritual...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's an ancient ritual that runs itself after taking shape.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: These are not modern Arts. Definitely not a modern tactic.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They are. This is very unusual. The Sarkaz we know today can't perform Arts like these.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand what you mean, Dr. Kal'tsit. This is an ancient Sarkaz ritual, not a product of the modern science of Originium Arts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our enemy here may be of the 'purest' Sarkaz. These are techniques not known to any modern country, passed down only among ancient Sarkaz and Sargonian nomads.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...The ritual relies on Oripathy infection, and the caster's peculiar understanding of Originium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The chaotic energy is seeping out of the Originium core, spilling out and enveloping the entire block.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't even imagine how the potent tempest at the center of the ritual would affect a living being.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It wouldn't know the difference between friend or foe... any living thing would be slowly pulled apart by the waves of energy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It doesn't seem useful for modern combat. The cost far outweighs any potential gain.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Cannibalism.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The phrasing may seem alarmist, but that's how this ritual is called.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's not surprising that the device at the center of the ritual is called an altar, considering how horrifically destructive it is. That the uninitiated refer to this as 'witchcraft.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I don't think ordinary Sarkaz mercenaries know how to use these kinds of Arts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You would have to have extensive Arts knowledge and combat experience from Kazdel to be able to pull off this ritual. And you wouldn't actually need to be a caster.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But he... he's only a Kazdel Sarkaz. Not one of the descendants of the ancient Sarkaz still wandering around the world.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Dr. Kal'tsit, is this second layer of protective equipment designed to protect against the Sarkaz Arts?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Not entirely. The amount of energy the ritual is producing exceeds the maximum tolerance of our equipment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This ritual can only be completed successfully in a city lost to Catastrophe.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our gear will not negate the effects of the ritual. Its power derives from antiquity, and cannot be separated from it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All we can do is mitigate its lethality, and destroy it after clearing the area.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A Sarkaz ritual is not only a challenge to modern technology.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's almost as if it's standing to once again challenge the other civilizations of this world, as the Sarkaz have plotted throughout history.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes. But Sarkaz history is more than metaphorical.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Reunion element guarding Chernobog is not a typical group. I've said as much already.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Reunion may very well rely on 'hubs' in 'neural networks' to operate as a single unit on a large scale.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But for today's purely push-strategy driven environment, Reunion would be something of an anomaly.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Imagine if soldiers who could not deal with the Infected, with no training in how to fight Sarkaz, infiltrated the core city...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They would suffer a crushing defeat.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Right.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then... let me think...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Dr. {@nickname}, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The places where the enemy performed the Sarkaz rituals must be important locations, or critical transport hubs.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They're much more familiar with the terrain than we are. They would have mapped out all the paths long before we could... They must have had defenses in place before we even started our operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The only advantage we have is our intelligence. We know how they're deployed, and they know nothing about us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...So we move quickly to wipe out the enemies guarding this area. The faster we do it, the safer we'll be. Don't let them alert the other guards.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't even think about an ambush. We can't waste time here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right. I will help with the assault.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm, okay... I think...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, look, I think, if...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Alright.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you don't need my assistance, Dr. {@nickname}.

options: Is there something I can help with?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Please help Amiya command the operation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You will evaluate the progress of the battle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis, we're moving out!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll vacate the area after this battle and head to the core city surface!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis... at least it'll be sunny.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Sunny~

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Heh. Look at them.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (The rest is up to you, Dr. {@nickname}. I know you won't let us down.)
Kal'tsit, we won't see that disappointment again.
You never step into the same river twice. There won't be a second time.
Even with the same person, the same thing... in a different time, we'll have a different outcome. This world... will change.
You believe it, don't you?
Yes... It makes sense that you wouldn't.
But I believe it. Dr. {@nickname}, a person like that... I know... if it wasn't this time right now, Dr. {@nickname} would be different.
I've seen a lot, so very many... Even if everyone else won't, I can understand.
Kal'tsit... Kal'tsit.
If... we had a little more time... you and I...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (You can prove you're not the Dr. {@nickname} that was stuck in the past.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (In this time...)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (No matter how, Dr. {@nickname}, you have to.)
